verdict.rationale: Every Gitea instance ships an interactive Swagger UI at /api/swagger, enabled by default and backed by the instance's own OpenAPI document. Its try-it feature runs requests against the live API, and the vendor docs and the live gitea.com instance both confirm this. The probe 404s on docs.gitea.com paths don't contradict it, because the spec is served per instance at /swagger.v1.json. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of the try-it experience, and a documented hosted sandbox or test instance for running examples safely (try.gitea.io no longer resolves and demo.gitea.com is undocumented).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Every Gitea instance ships an interactive Swagger UI reference at /api/swagger (mounted against the instance's own OpenAPI document, so try-it executes against the live instance API)
API Reference guide is auto-generated by swagger and available on: https://gitea.your.host/api/swagger
The OpenAPI document is at: https://gitea.your.host/swagger.v1.json
